threading: Real TopCmds calls, including context and preview when using CURDATA, must execute on a TopSpin CmdThread. No Swing or thread creation in the backend.

methods.ensure_demo_inputs(config): Explicit demo setup action: seeds isolated synthetic files and returns context. Demo only. Use before instrument_setup.prepare_working_dataset; preview never creates files.
methods.run(config, action='prepare', callback=N: action prepare/acquire/analyze; returns status,plan,output_dir,result,events,demo,callback_errors. Errors raise WorkflowError and save diagnostics. Operator stops return status=stopped.
methods.apply_p1(config, p90_us, target_expno, r: Requires latest P1 result in this controller and reviewed=True; copies only parameters to new EXPNO, verifies matching RF power/nucleus/probe, writes P1 locally only. Returns status=applied and source/target/provenance. Never acquires.

config_flat.dataset_name: optional if real API CURDATA available; ignored for explicit demo
config_flat.data_root: directory containing dataset_name; optional with API; ignored for explicit demo
config_flat.p1_values_us: list or comma-separated values; default 2.2..48.4 step2.2
config_flat.gradient_values_percent: list or comma-separated values; default8..96 step4
config_flat.ppm_low: required numeric for acquire/analyze; demo default4.5
config_flat.ppm_high: required numeric for acquire/analyze; demo default4.9
config_flat.gradient_b100_override_s_m2: 0 by default. If >0, treated solely as an explicitly supplied PREVIOUS b100 for Dmeasured and G-ratio comparison. Never replaces the empirically calibrated b100=slope/Dref.
config_flat.report_dir: base output directory; each operation gets a new UUID directory
config_flat.analysis_expnos: optional list or range expression10-32; must match sweep values count
config_flat.apply_source_expno: optional; default p1_template_expno, parameter-only source for reviewed application

callback_event.message: human-readable fallback; GUI should translate stage labels

plot_result.p1: x=P1 us, y=signed integral; result also has P90_us/P180_us/R2
plot_result.demo_label: result.demo=true and result.evidence_type explicitly mark synthetic/noiseless demonstration

prepare_then_acquire: Only plans prepared and recorded by the same controller instance may acquire existing parameter-only targets. Changed parameter files, collisions or prior FIDs block. Acquisition can auto-prepare when destinations are free.
stop: Accept Python Event.is_set/isSet, Java AtomicBoolean.get, callable or boolean. Checked before each parameter copy and between acquired points; active ZG/EFP finishes before stopping.
demo: Creates isolated report_dir/demo_inputs/session_UUID/DEMO_DOSY; seeds P1 template1000 P1=22us with trueP90=11us and gradient template10 with D=1.15e-9,b100=2e9. Uses real binary reader, integration and fitting. No TopCmds API is accepted in demo mode.
dependencies: Reuse preloaded _dosy_autorun/_dosy_calibration/_dosy_console_ui/_dosy_ramp_engine; otherwise loads sibling topspin_console_v3/dist/dosy_workshop_v3.py. Root can embed v3 then this module without Swing dependency.
